description: This source file implements the 'RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector' class, which is responsible for filtering silos based on matching specified metadata keys during placement decisions in Orleans runtime.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: A class that filters available silos by matching their metadata with the local silo's metadata based on specified keys.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters the list of silos based on whether their metadata matches the local silo's metadata as per the specified metadata keys.

methods.name: DoesMetadataMatch
methods.description: Checks if the metadata from the local silo matches the remote silo's metadata for all specified keys.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata values from a SiloMetadata object for the specified keys.
